# Culture & copy

## Audience
Saudi and Gulf families in Riyadh: new mothers, working parents, adult children caring for their parents, pet owners. Family-first, privacy-conscious; they value trust and respect.

## Tone
Warm, respectful, calm, confident. Plain words. Speak to the family ("your home", "your children"); never sell hard. Sentence case. Active voice. Buttons say what happens: "Book on WhatsApp", not "Submit".

## Arabic first
- Write the Arabic first in natural, Saudi-friendly Modern Standard Arabic, then the English. Never translate word for word.
- Mark Arabic that needs a native check with `REVIEW-AR` (a comment next to the string).
- Islamic courtesy where natural (e.g. «بإذن الله») in moderation. No religious claims.

## Never write
licensed, certified, nurse, nursing, medical, hospital-grade, MOH, 24/7, "500+ families" or any statistic, reviews, testimonials, ratings, stars. No prices beyond `src/data/packages.ts` (draft).

## Allowed trust claims
- Staff are background-checked.
- Booking happens on WhatsApp.
- One caregiver can combine several services.

## Modesty
Women in hijab or modest dress, men in modest dress, Gulf home interiors. No music, parties, alcohol or immodest imagery.

Seasonal content: Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha; Saudi Founding Day and Saudi National Day (national occasions); White Friday and back to school (commercial). No other religious occasions.

## Social proof
None until it is real. Use the "Be among our first families" block instead.
